items.title: AI text watermarking and quality loss
items.summary: After the EU AI Act’s transparency guidelines went into effect, and following the announcement that most major AI labs will soon be watermarking their text output to comply, there has been some debate about how much of an impact this is going to have, if any, on the quality of the text produced by AI models.
